statement: Naive cosimplicial divided-power replacement is not homotopy equivalent in complexes of simplicial modules and fails underived sections: H2 on sk2 B(C2) is zero versus Z/2 for the PD Koszul complex
depends_on: Exact Dold-Kan; explicit integral normalization matrices
notes: Canonical objectwise quasi-isomorphism has contractible kernel but is not split simplicially; weight2 sphere comparison is multiplication by2. Does not refute every possible filtered binomial model.
